finalText:
All 5 tests pass now.

The bug was in `computeTotal` in `src/services/pricing.js:9-23`: flat-amount coupons are stored in USD (per `coupon.js`), but the code was subtracting the raw USD coupon amount from the total *after* it had already been converted to the target currency — treating a USD amount as if it were in the target currency. Fixed by subtracting the flat coupon in USD before conversion, so it gets converted along with the rest of the total (percent coupons still apply after conversion, since they're currency-agnostic).
